purpose: Teach: 誓い/あれだけ/家内/伯父/和室/帰れる/仕立て/籠

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんとの、本気で、絶対、誓い、絶対、覚えてるか?本気で
lines.en: Gran — do you remember when your father and I made that serious vow when we were young?
lines.style: Soft opening, eyes distant. Quiet searching tone. Pause before the question, like he's reaching back through decades. Gentle, not urgent.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、あれだけ、絶対、お働きになったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Yes. I remember how hard your father worked back then, dear. It was something, wasn't it?
lines.style: Warm and certain. A small smile in the voice. She meets his memory halfway. Tender but steady — not sentimental.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさんが、本気で、絶対、家内、絶対、として、絶対、支えてくれたぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: And you supported me as a wife through all of it. Do you remember that?
lines.style: Quieter now. Gratitude underneath. Speaking slowly, giving weight to each memory. A man acknowledging something that mattered deeply.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃんの、本気で、絶対、伯父、絶対、様、絶対、お優しかったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Your father was so kind to us back then, wasn't he, dear? I remember it all.
lines.style: Bright thread of warmth. She's not correcting him — she's walking alongside. Voice steady and full, the voice of someone who knows these years well.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、和室、絶対、で、絶対、お茶、絶対、淹れてくれたぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: You'd make tea for me in the Japanese room, remember? Just like that.
lines.style: Eyes closed slightly. Speaking as if he can see it happening. Slow, almost reverent pace. The smallest smile. One specific image held tenderly.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、帰れる、絶対、時間、絶対、いつも、絶対、遅かったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: You were always so late coming home in those days, weren't you? But I didn't mind. I remember.
lines.style: Gently teasing undertone wrapped in affection. She's not complaining — she's acknowledging. Warm, a little knowing. The voice of a long marriage.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、お父さんの、絶対、仕立て、絶対、のスーツ、絶対、ほめてくれたぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: And you'd compliment my father's tailored suits. I remember you doing that.
lines.style: Quieter. A small thing — but he's kept it. Slow cadence. Voice full of tender precision, like he's handling something fragile.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、お花、絶対、籠、絶対、いっぱい、絶対、お持ち帰りなさったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: You brought home baskets and baskets of flowers, didn't you, dear? I remember every one.
lines.style: Voice full and present. Not wistful like his — she's lived in these moments comfortably. Bright with affection. A woman who kept what mattered close.
